funProjects.name: IgnisCore
funProjects.description: A multi-platform framework for custom Minecraft blocks, items, and runtime extensions. Supports Spigot, Paper, and Sponge with a deployable extension system and documentation site.

funProjects.name: PermissionsExPlus
funProjects.description: A maintained fork of PermissionsEx providing multi-platform permission management for Bukkit, BungeeCord, Velocity, and Sponge. Includes migration tooling, modern and legacy APIs, and comprehensive documentation.

funProjects.name: Spotify Streaming History Explorer
funProjects.description: A browser-based tool for exploring Spotify Extended Streaming History exports. Upload JSON files, filter listening data, and browse interactive charts — all processed locally on your device.

funProjects.name: VibeGame
funProjects.description: An open-world voxel sandbox game built through AI-assisted development. Features procedurally generated biomes, real-time terrain editing, and ore discovery across a surreal fantasy world.

funProjects.name: ProxyChat
funProjects.description: A cross-server chat plugin for BungeeCord and Waterfall. Supports toggleable and ignorable chats, customisable messages, cooldowns, tab completion, and colour formatting.
